# Iteration 005 / Phase 5.3 — Controlled refinement

This workspace is the audited-refinement stage built from the frozen raw-generation results of iteration 5.2.

At this snapshot only Candidate **M** is populated. The remaining candidate directories are intentionally empty and will be added one architecture at a time after independent pairwise audits.

For M, `Run-02` was selected as the refinement baseline. The original selected template is immutable under `M/baseline/template/`. Refinement must be generated only into `M/output/template/` by following `M/REFINEMENT_TASK.md` with the prompt in `M/GOAL_PROMPT.txt`.

Phase 5.2 remains the raw evidence. Do not overwrite it from this workspace.
